newsitem.title: UK: Kleinwort top UK economic forecasters - survey.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort top UK economic forecasters - survey.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson's London-based economists have been voted top UK economic forecasters by British fund managers, a Reuter survey out on Tuesday shows.

The survey, conducted for Reuters by Tempest Consulting, showed the Kleinwort team, which includes David Owen and Leo Doyle, pushed Natwest Securities into second place. Geoffrey Dicks' NatWest team headed last year's list.
Some 15.17 percent of British fund managers said Kleinwort Benson were the best UK economic forecasters, up from 12.96 percent last year.
Natwest received 14.91 percent of the vote, down from 18.52 percent last year. The votes of fund managers were weighted according to how much money is under their control.
